envelope: UiEventSchema wraps every event with schemaVersion literal 1, eventId, conversationId, sequence, occurredAt and eventType
compatibilityBasis: The Gateway, the fixture Gateway and the browser client all parse this exact schema. Any field, enum or event change requires a reviewed contract update plus a refreshed digest and eventTypes list here; a silent change fails tests/ui/security/conformance.test.ts.
limitations: Digest evidence detects source drift; it is not a negotiated wire version between independently deployed clients and the Gateway.
